cta.title: Choose your sponsor for season {season}
cta.body: Five sponsors are at the table, each with its own way of paying you. Compare the deals and lock in your backing.
cta.pendingBody: You have signed a deal for the upcoming season. You can still switch to a different offer until the season starts.

offers.title: Choose your sponsor
offers.subtitle: Five sponsors, five ways to earn — season {season}.
offers.unitDefinition: 1 race day = one stage your team starts.

offers.empty: No offers are available right now. A new deal can be negotiated once the current contract is up for renewal.
offers.confirmBody: Sign with {sponsor} for {count, plural, one {# season} other {# seasons}}? You can change your pick until season {season} starts.
offers.boardNote: Board satisfaction adjusts the guaranteed payout by up to ±20%. Bonuses are paid as they happen.
